purpose: Preserve original 1984 Fiero documentation for future model-year expansion. No current app source or central catalog changed.

documents.printing: 3rd Printing, explicitly printed on PDF page 108 (manual page 7-2)

reviewedPages.finding: Cover explicitly reads 1984 Fiero Owner’s Manual with Pontiac branding.
Original Pontiac/GM title and contents page explicitly names 1984 Pontiac Fiero; covers introduction and sections 1, 2, 2A–2D, 3–7.
Original printed page 7-2 Service Station Information; footer identifies Part No. 10028873 C, 3rd Printing.
Back cover carries Pontiac/GM marks and Part No. 10028873 C.

documents.qualification: Usable nonblank original-year scan: all 109 PDF pages render with image content and non-uniform grayscale pixels; cover, contents, final printed service-station page and back cover opened. This does not verify page-by-page sequence/completeness, every technical value, later errata, or applicability to 1985 or other years.
documents.replacesForUsabilityOnly: references/year-library/2026-10-01/1984-owners.pdf remains preserved as the previously unusable blank archive response.

serviceManualSearch.finding: Archive folder titled 1984 Factory Service Manual lists only 1984 Fiero Electrical Troubleshooting.pdf. That section is not a complete S-8410P manual. Existing acquired 1984 electrical revision remains in the central library.
serviceManualSearch.boundedSearchOutcome: No full free original 1984 factory service PDF acquired. Public searches surfaced paid print/reproduction listings, which were not purchased or treated as downloaded evidence.

otherDiscovery.finding: Search/web text shows matching original-owner-manual content, but direct HTML download returned HTTP 403. No PDF acquired there and no access-control bypass attempted.

policy: Preserved original scans are not app-distribution assets.
Preserve publication printing and model-year applicability separately; this is not a new year selector or an interchangeability claim.
